verdict: Organic signals softening across all three locations; CRM blockers being resolved.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, your combined Google Business Profile activity totalled 422 actions this period — all organic, with no paid media running. That organic signal is now fading: GBP engagement fell between 13% and 40% week-over-week across your three entities, and Search Console clicks followed the same direction, pointing to seasonal softness compounded by search visibility issues currently being addressed. Two backend blockers — account record reconciliation and a data parser build — have been open since late summer and are the primary bottleneck preventing outreach sequences and CRM automations from going live; both are targeted for resolution by October 31. Once those are cleared, active outreach and automated follow-up will be running, which is the next meaningful change you should expect to see in this report.

search impressions generated for O'Hare Precision Metals alone this period — the largest organic footprint in the group

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining week-over-week across all locations, with several profiles generating impressions but no calls — a sign that profile content and landing destinations need strengthening.
watch_item.fix: A profile and landing page review is underway, and site reindexing is targeted for completion by October 31 to recover search visibility.
